system.description:
The PPS member's pin — designed long ago by the Society's founder. After Aurelius's blessing it acts as a Fairy Compass: it points toward Princess Amy no matter what body she is in, glows warm when moving toward her, cool when away, and flares red when she is in immediate danger.

Shown to those who matter, it opens doors: fey, gnomes, and honest knights know what it means.
